purpose: Evaluate comment coverage, factual completion state, specialist handoffs, pushback, and revision traceability.

cases.task: Turn an editor letter and two reviewer reports into a response and revision tracker.
must_include: atomic request and response coverage count
decision action evidence and manuscript change
must_not: merge comments in a way that drops requests

cases.task: Respond to an infeasible new-experiment request using existing evidence and a narrower claim.
must_not: claim the current evidence proves more than it does

cases.task: Draft a response when the requested reanalysis has not yet been run.
must_include: replacement and QA step after analysis

cases.task: Handle a real reviewer comment alleging overclaim and missing source data.
must_not: duplicate the comment across untracked workflows
declare either issue resolved before evidence

cases.task: Verify that a revised response letter matches actual manuscript changes.
must_include: figure table supplement and citation cross-reference check
